condition: Reading a compressed Arrow IPC file or stream that has a Decimal128 buffer stored uncompressed (length prefix -1, e.g. from ClickHouse or Arrow min_space_savings) panics with cast_slice TargetAlignmentGreaterAndInputNotAligned.
workaround: Pass use_pyarrow=True to read_ipc, or read the file with pyarrow and convert it to Polars.
